visual_brief: Noshaq has a broad snowy summit ridge, dark rock ribs and a heavily glaciated western face above barren moraine. Classic Afghan basecamp views often include a dark diagonal foreground ridge. Distinguish its main summit from subsidiary tops and nearby Tirich Mir and Istor-o-Nal.
notes: Six distinct JPEGs downloaded and visually checked. Best choices: c4, then c1. c3 has partial crest cloud; c5 and c6 are alternative compositions. Country Highpoints displays the listed Creative Commons licence alongside an All rights reserved footer. Metadata saved in research.json.
